source: Oklahoma Tax Commission Packet OW-2 2026 withholding tables (H.B. 2764, eff. Jan 1, 2026: six brackets consolidated to three positive rates, top rate 4.75%→4.50%): standard deduction $6,350 single / $12,700 married; $1,000 personal-exemption withholding allowance each; single taxable-income brackets 0% to $3,750, 2.5% to $4,900, 3.5% to $7,200, 4.5% above (married doubled). NOTE: HB 2764 contains a revenue-trigger for a further 0.25pp cut — not reflected.
